Results.ReviewText: This is the best grill I've ever owned. It heats up so fast you would never think it has only three burners. I don't even use the hottest setting anymore, even for searing. I was worried about the grates at first, but they were seasoned after three uses and are now smooth and easy to clean. I've had two cheaper grills in the past 8 years, and they are both now scrap metal because the burners and the bottoms just disintegrated. The replacement parts cost more than the original price of the grills, so it was time for something different. If the burners on this one last 5 years I'll never get another brand.
Results.Title: Best Grill I've Ever Owned

Results.ReviewText: So far so good!  Started using it first part of March 2020.  First new Weber grill I have purchased in over 10 years but I have never been without a Weber Grill since the 1970's.  Since we have been told to stay home throughout the Corona Virus situation we have been getting creative with our Weber and it has helped us keep our sanity.  Great online and app resources for recipes etc.  We are now hoping to be able to afford buying the rotisserie accessory, digital thermometer and a couple other items.  Maybe Weber should offer a special online offer to everyone held hostage during these challenging times.  The Weber Corona Virus COVID-19 Sanity Rescue SPECIAL with discounts and incentives for users and new potential customers.  Also, consider doing an online ZOOM or other grilling challenges, special speakers-presenters showing tips and recipes with live Q&A sessions like what other online services are doing during this time.  KEEP AMERICA GRILLING GREAT WEBER!  Thank you and all your employees who are helping us Americans keep our taste buds healthy and smiling throughout this unusual situation.  We are all dreaming of summer picnics with our families and being closer than 6 feet apart.
Results.Title: New Weber Grill helping us Cope with Covid-19

Overall very happy and can't wait for the summer.

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
